CustomField.label: Prerequisite Check
CustomField.description: Optional. Enter the Record Name (API Name / DeveloperName, shown in the Name column in Setup - NOT the "Check Title" users see) of another active check in the same Check Set that must PASS before this check runs. The prerequisite must have a lower "Evaluation Order". Complete Check Set runs skip this check when the prerequisite does not pass or cannot be resolved. Single-Check API, Flow, Agent, and Lightning requests evaluate the selected Check without loading this dependency. Validate the Check Set to find a missing, inactive, later-ordered, or circular prerequisite.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: For Check Set runs, the Record Name of an earlier Check that must pass first. Single-Check requests do not enforce prerequisites. Validate the Check Set to find missing, inactive, later-ordered, or circular dependencies.
